behavior: A sticky per-connection cancellation signal ends an upgraded relay independently of socket EOF, including when the idle timeout is disabled.
ownership: Only the connection worker closes descriptors. Shutdown and reaping signal cancellation before interrupting sockets; slot registration resets the signal after the prior owner unregisters.

commands: zig build fmt test console-ui-e2e -j2 --verbose --summary all
qualification.constraints: Original full native gates, assertions and 45-minute job cap retained; no logging overlay or test skips in this candidate qualification.

focused_regression.scenario: Both live socket peers remain open, relay idle timeout is disabled, and cancellation is signalled without interrupting either socket before checking completion.

negative.change: Remove only the relay cancellation observation; retain the signal, live peers, assertion and failure cleanup.
negative.cleanup: After the bounded assertion, cleanup interrupts owned sockets and joins the worker.

historical_evidence.identified_stack: CRS WebSocket early-release test teardown waits in Fixture.destroy and connection Pool.join while one worker remains in duplex.relay.
historical_evidence.original_local_results: Exact-tag macOS 27.0 passed 100 isolated WebSocket repetitions and all 33 native CRS tests.
historical_evidence.diagnosis_limit: The original macOS 15 kernel-readiness mechanism remains unclassified. This qualification establishes the explicit cancellation lifecycle guarantee, not an explanation of that mechanism.

release_limit: This gate qualifies the two-file cancellation overlay against the original tag. Combined final-source platform and cluster gates are still required before publication.
